summary: Reviewed the three asserted accounts against evidence that arrived after they were written, looking for claims later receipts had overtaken. The transfer account still matches its two receipts — reported-success mismatch, the ~277ms leaderless span, the differing successor between runs, and the counterevidence that favours the library (the untargeted call filters non-voters; an undeliverable TimeoutNow is an error). The shutdown account matches all five revisions, including the racing form's non-reproduction, the unbuffered contrast, the per-call split, the repository's own TODO, and the removed occupancy explanation, with limitations naming the 500ms classification, the single-voter in-memory setting and the over-subscribed cases. The verify account had just been corrected by the stale-read probe. Nothing needed correcting, so the submission carried only that rationale and the validator returned no_change with no record effects — the honest outcome for a review that found no changes. The run is settled: five questions each with an account and receipts, three defects asserted with reproduced witnesses, one child question refuted for the model it tested, one configuration-history lead refuted by source reasoning, and twelve knowledge entries, most of them reusable Behaviours about voter eligibility, election timing and configuration discipline. No further lead is open, so I am not manufacturing one; if the run continues I would look for a genuinely new sourced question rather than revisit what is already reproduced.
